differences.what: A module, exam_heent_mouth, that the General note type includes: its section Mouth / throat shows only while HEENT (exam.systems is heent) is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal.

differences.what: Oral mucosa is choose-many. Moist is the normal option and is not exclusive: moist mucosa can have lesions, ulcers or thrush. Moist excludes Dry.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 13, 17, 26 (a reading of default 13: Moist describes one quality of the mucosa, not all of it)

differences.what: Dentition is choose-many. Normal is the normal option and clears the others.
Pharynx is choose-many. Clear is the normal option and clears the others.
Airway is choose-many. Patent is the normal option and clears the others.
